verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting platform and its SDK/MCP tooling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'invoice tracking' feature is about seeing when a customer opens an invoice, not about user telemetry controls, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
